คลินิกผิวหนัง ศิริยศ
text: The doctor was kind, made an accurate diagnosis, and scraped a scab from the rash for microscopic examination. The results came back in 10-15 minutes. It turned out to be an allergic rash, not a fungal infection. I received oral and topical medication and improved within a week. The cost of the examination and medication was around 1,000 to 2,000 baht. The next appointment's medication cost no more than 3,000 baht. I highly recommend this clinic.
